test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: S is a female member of a family and has three children. M is the son of S. M is the maternal uncle of two girls who are not sisters, but whose mothers are siblings. Based on the information provided, which of the following statements is most likely to be true?

options.text: S has one son, one daughter and third cannot be determined.
S has two sons, one daughter.
S has one son, two daughters.
S has one son, and the other two cannot be determined.

solution:
• Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2224c1c989f25b6e9780b5293027a990568840c2b08eb5ad155ceee6e32899c.png] 

 
• Based on the information given in the question, the family tree will be as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f684ca2c8002a9ddf9de79eb632291c09c7a81853f278841ac1433d8ab5603f4.png] 

♦ Let C and D be the girls whose maternal uncle is M.

♦ Let A and B be the mothers of C and D respectively.

Thus, S has one son and two daughters.

Hence, **'option 3' **is the correct answer.
